name: Macbeth II.2 · The daggers

performers.name: Macbeth II.2 · Macbeth
performers.represents: Macbeth, a tall adult man about 40-45; screen-left, facing his wife; holds the two bloody daggers in his right hand

parts.name: 0-3 s: stands rigid holding the daggers; she asks why he brought them
3-6 s: "I won't go back. I can't look at it again."
6-8 s: lets her take the daggers
8-10 s: empty-handed, looks down at his hand

performers.name: Macbeth II.2 · Lady Macbeth
performers.represents: Lady Macbeth, an adult woman; screen-right, facing her husband

parts.name: 0-3 s: "Why did you bring the daggers here? They belong with the guards."
3-6 s: listens; at 5.3 s "Give them to me."
6-8 s: takes the daggers with her left hand
8-10 s: holds the daggers; "I'll put them back."

props.name: daggers
props.represents: the two bloody daggers, held together by the hilts, blades down

cameras.name: Shot 1: Lady Macbeth chest-up over Macbeth's shoulder
Shot 2: Macbeth chest-up, reverse, same side of the line
Shot 3: waist-up two-shot holding the hand-over

beats.speaker: lady
beats.line: Why did you bring the daggers here? They belong with the guards.
beats.text: Macbeth stands rigid, the daggers in his hand; Lady Macbeth faces him.

beats.speaker: macbeth
beats.line: I won't go back. I can't look at it again.

beats.text: She reaches out and takes the daggers from his hand.

beats.speaker: lady
beats.text: She holds the daggers; he looks down at his empty hand.

notes: Act II Scene 2 adaptation, the hand-over beat only; lines are newly written modern English in the style of the Act I Scene 7 version, not Shakespeare's text.

The room follows the Act I Scene 7 antechamber master (door back left, sideboard with candles centre, curtained window right). Macbeth screen-left, Lady Macbeth screen-right, cameras south of their line as in Scene 7.
Nobody steps; they stand 0.9 m apart, as the hand-over needs.
